segments.name: social media
segments.description: Operates a global online community platform where users post and vote on content, selling advertising, subscriptions and content licensing.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment as our chief operating decision maker, our Chief Executive Officer, reviews consolidated profitability measures in managing the business.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay Reddit for access to its engaged audience, with other revenue from content licensing and Reddit Premium subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: For advertisers, we provide access to a unique and highly engaged audience where our trusted, passionate communities drive recommendations on brands and buying decisions.
